question: Will Shohei Ohtani hit at least 43 home runs in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves to YES is Shohei Ohtani hits 43 home runs in 2026 during the regular season. Otherwise resolves to NO

The MLB regular season will end on September 27, 2026.

- I found no report of another home run between Aug. 19 and Sept. 12. As of the forecast date his total appears to be **30**, so he needs **13 more**.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-11: The Dodgers put Ohtani on the 15-day injured list, backdated to Sept. 8, for right biceps inflammation. Left knee soreness was also a factor, and he had not improved enough over the previous week. [NBC Los Angeles](https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/sports/shohei-ohtani-dodgers-injured-list/3940031/); [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-out-of-lineup-again-vs-reds)
- Because of the backdating, the earliest he can return is about Sept. 23. The regular season ends Sept. 27, which leaves him roughly 4 to 5 games at most.
- In practice this nearly settles the question: he would need 13 home runs in about five games. The single-game MLB record is 4.

- 2026-07-28: His 10th leadoff homer, which was his 23rd of the season. [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-hits-10th-leadoff-homer-of-2026)
- MLB.com noted that his 2026 total ran about 12 behind his 2025 pace, while his overall production was similar. [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-2026-home-run-total-overall-production)

## 4. Base rates
- His recent full seasons: 46 (2021), 34 (2022), 44 (2023), 54 (2024), 55 (2025). His 2026 pace was clearly lower, at about 30 through Aug. 18.
- His best home run month is about 15. Even at his peak he averaged roughly one home run every 3 to 4 games.
- The MLB record for one month is 20 (Sammy Sosa, June 1998), and the record for one game is 4. No player has ever hit 13 in about five games, so the historical base rate is effectively 0%.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets on this threshold. Season-long home run prop lines set before the season are out of date.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About Sept. 23: the earliest he can come off the IL. The team could also keep him out longer to protect him for the postseason, since the Dodgers are a playoff team.
- Sept. 27: last day of the regular season.
- The only paths to YES would be a data error or an unprecedented burst of home runs. The biceps, knee and slump problems make heavy playing time unlikely.
